name: Reconnaissance in the Necropolis: Discovery of the Archeotech Vaults

cycle_advancement.world_state: Archeotech Vaults Identified in Ancient City (0,0)

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The expedition navigates the cyclopean avenues of the Sunken Necropolis. Sensor readings confirm an intact pre-Imperial plasma generator and an automated Munitorum armory cache locked behind an adamantine cipher gate.

completed_milestones.title: Archeotech Vaults Discovered in the Ruined Ancient City
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Vane, Bragg, and Jax completed a forward stealth sweep of the Sunken Necropolis, uncovering two legendary prizes: a dormant Archaeotech Plasma Core and an unlooted heavy ordnance cache, guarded by a slumbering Kastelan-pattern Automaton.

loc_ancient_ruined_city.threat: Dormant Kastelan Automaton 'Iron Aegis' & Logic Cipher Lock

corpse_starch_ration_bars.unit: ration blocks (-75 consumed by expedition and garrison)

new_decision.decision: Conducted a disciplined stealth reconnaissance of the Sunken Necropolis with Jax and Bragg; identified an intact archeotech Plasma Core in the central reactor rotunda and located a sealed Munitorum ordnance vault.
new_decision.impact: Pinpointed the exact salvage objectives and established observation points without triggering the slumbering defense grid.

new_decision.decision: Held his breath and moved like an iron shadow behind the Sarge, successfully bypassing a dormant Kastelan combat servitor without disturbing its auditory tripwires.
new_decision.impact: Demonstrated unnatural Ogryn discipline, keeping the strike team completely undetected.

new_decision.decision: Used his sump-scout optical auspex to map the power cabling connecting the archeotech generator to the vault blast locks, reporting back to Vane with precise schematic sketches.
new_decision.impact: Identified the override manual breaker, allowing the squad to bypass the lethal security grid.
